svg.title: Three gains from the root locus, stepped on the shaft
svg.desc: With Kp 12 the shaft is still 0.027 radians short after 2 seconds; Kp 16 is within 0.02 radians from 1.46 seconds without overshoot; Kp 20 settles fastest but its first torque uses the drive's whole 20 newton-metres.
svg.text: Three gains from the root locus, stepped on the shaft
Control Studio recordings of this project · Kd = 7 N·m·s/rad fixed · numbers answer the predictions
Kp = 12: 0.973 rad after 2 s, too slow
Kp = 20: first torque 20 N·m, the whole drive
